label: Vocal Video
description: Collect video testimonials, manage replies, galleries and storyboards

operations.name: get_account_usage
operations.description: Read workspace totals, usage meters and allowances. The publish, video-request and AI-credit meters are separate.

operations.name: list_collectors
operations.description: Find workspace video collectors. Results are a ranked shortlist; when truncated, narrow the filters rather than treating matched as a workspace total.

operations.name: get_collector
operations.description: Read a collector, its ordered prompts, copy and settings.

operations.name: create_collector
operations.description: Create a video request campaign, optionally with AI-generated prompts. New collectors are active immediately; AI generation spends credits.

operations.name: update_collector
operations.description: Change selected collector copy and settings. Only supplied fields are sent; explicit null clears release, reward or template overrides.

operations.name: set_collector_status
operations.description: Activate a collector or pause it so its link stops accepting submissions.

operations.name: send_collector_invitation
operations.description: Preview invitation recipients with confirm=false. After confirming the preview, run again with the same recipients/message, confirm=true and the returned confirmation_token. Sending emails spends one video-request credit per recipient.

operations.name: list_replies
operations.description: Find video/audio responses using transcript and respondent filters. Retains locked and pending-indexing indicators; pending indexing does not mean the workspace is empty.

operations.name: get_reply
operations.description: Read a selected video/audio response and its footage details.

operations.name: star_reply
operations.description: Mark a response as a workspace favorite.

operations.name: unstar_reply
operations.description: Remove a response from workspace favorites.

operations.name: list_galleries
operations.description: Find workspace galleries. Results are a shortlist; narrow filters when truncated.

operations.name: get_gallery
operations.description: Read gallery details and item slot IDs.

operations.name: create_gallery
operations.description: Create a gallery with optional published storyboards and uploaded clips. Unpublished storyboards and response clips are rejected by Vocal Video.

operations.name: add_storyboard_to_gallery
operations.description: Add one or several published videos to a gallery in the supplied order.

operations.name: remove_from_gallery
operations.description: Remove an item from a gallery by slot ID, or by storyboard/clip ID. Slot ID from get_gallery is preferred.

operations.name: get_gallery_share_url
operations.description: Get a gallery sharing URL without changing its visibility.

operations.name: get_gallery_embed_code
operations.description: Get a gallery embed snippet without changing its visibility.

operations.name: list_storyboards
operations.description: Find workspace videos by content, publication and visibility. Shortlist results are not workspace totals.

operations.name: get_storyboard_summary
operations.description: Read the lighter video metadata and design summary without the scene list.

operations.name: get_storyboard
operations.description: Read a selected video and its scenes, or request the lighter summary.

operations.name: set_storyboard_metadata
operations.description: Change public video title/description and the internal workspace title.

operations.name: set_storyboard_visibility
operations.description: Set video visibility to public and searchable, unlisted link access, or private workspace access.

operations.name: get_storyboard_share_url
operations.description: Get a video sharing URL without changing its visibility.

operations.name: get_storyboard_embed_code
operations.description: Get video embed HTML with optional layout, playback and display settings.
